keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

keywords.name: Physics-aware ML
keywords.about: Physics-aware networks and neural ODEs model lesions, reaction-diffusion, and XRD spectra.

keywords.name: Hallucination detection
keywords.about: Detectors are audited on quantized models, and reasoning failures are recovered in clinical LMs.

keywords.name: Activation steering
keywords.about: Steering vectors and direction-based ablation remove refusals or shift agent behavior.

keywords.name: Coding agents
keywords.about: Software agents are studied through behavioral trajectories, review bias, and code-graph evaluation.

keywords.name: LLM agents
keywords.about: Agents filter memory, resist collusion, query crystallography databases, and write SQL.

keywords.name: Vision-language models
keywords.about: VLMs are probed for adversarial robustness, CLIP concept transfer, and document parsing.

keywords.name: On-device inference
keywords.about: Small quantized models and local servers bring LLM inference and RL runtime to edge devices.

keywords.name: Domain adaptation
keywords.about: Adaptation pipelines transfer handwriting recognition and point-cloud segmentation across regions and scripts.

keywords.name: Anatomical
keywords.about: Models segment tumors, synthesize cine images, and answer medical visual questions.

keywords.name: VLA robot learning
keywords.about: Vision-language-action policies are post-trained, navigated indoors-to-outdoors, and reviewed for robotics.

keywords.name: Federated learning
keywords.about: Federated methods handle class-incremental EEG, dual-cone aggregation, and industrial anomaly detection.

keywords.name: Time-series forecasting
keywords.about: Foundation models, instance fine-tuning, and multimodal benchmarks target forecasting and anomaly detection.

keywords.name: Autonomous driving simulation
keywords.about: Simulators and adversarial attacks evaluate tracking, chassis dynamics, and traffic impact.

keywords.name: 3D reconstruction
keywords.about: Feed-forward multi-view transformers reconstruct scenes and accelerate long-video processing.

themes.name: LLM agents: evaluation, memory, and multi-agent safety
themes.summary: Papers benchmark and stress-test LLM agents, spanning memory filtering when resolver errors delete query-critical facts, time-consistent code benchmarks, and behavioral trajectory analysis. Others examine multi-agent settings, including coordination versus ensembling and test-time compute, alignment transfer, attacks by malicious agents, and collusion framing, alongside new benchmarks for long-horizon allocation, web navigation, spreadsheets, and patient simulation.

themes.name: Medical imaging and clinical prediction
themes.summary: Papers apply deep learning across medical imaging, from 2D-to-3D registration and tumour-aware IDH prediction to retinal OCT self-supervision, laryngeal lesion classification, and interactive segmentation. Clinical prediction work covers Cuffless Blood Pressure from PPG, uncertainty-aware cardiopulmonary risk, electrocardiographic imaging, and negative results against persistence baselines in ICU assessment.

themes.name: Physics-informed neural networks and scientific ML
themes.summary: Papers develop physics-informed and scientific machine learning methods, including PINNs for epidemics, fracture and PDE simulation, operator inference for reduced-order models, and weak-form regression for interaction kernels. Others apply generative and surrogate models to crystal structures, materials design, calorimeter showers, and particle tracking.

themes.name: Vision-language-action robot learning
themes.summary: Papers study vision-language-action models and embodied robot learning, covering failure-driven data engines, budget-conditioned navigation, humanoid indoor-to-outdoor navigation, and touch data via real-to-sim-to-real. Related work examines pre-trained visual representations, world action models, and safety-aware behavior planning.

themes.name: Interpretability and activation steering for LLMs
themes.summary: Papers interpret LLM internals and control behavior through activation interventions, including input-optimised steering vectors, persona steering, refusal ablation, and token-level steering. Others analyze chain-of-thought monitorability, confabulated beliefs about requests, latent persistence, and sparse autoencoder explanations for medical retrieval.

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference and serving
themes.summary: Papers address efficient LLM inference and serving, spanning adapter routing, mixture-of-experts kernels and ensembling routers, quantization formats and user-schedulable approximations, and speculative decoding over invalidated caches. Serving systems tackle decode jitter, distributed local serving, and layer folding for distillation.

themes.name: Hallucination detection and reliability evaluation
themes.summary: Papers evaluate hallucination and reliability, auditing detectors on small quantized on-device models, benchmarking hallucination in autoregressive text-to-image generation, and mitigating multilingual object hallucination in LVLMs. Related work covers focused verification of visual evidence, selective abstention, and black-box uncertainty quantification.

themes.name: 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis
themes.summary: Papers tackle 3D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis, including acceleration of multi-view 3D transformers, sparse-view Gaussian splatting regularisation, and learned bundle adjustment. Others address light field super-resolution, neural field encodings, and live depth-completed rendering.

themes.name: Time-series foundation models and forecasting
themes.summary: Papers build and adapt time-series foundation models, covering flexible context learning, sample-wise instance fine-tuning, spatio-temporal transfer, and benchmarks of long synthetic series. Related work forecasts chlorophyll-a and weather world models and diagnoses multimodal forecasting under aligned, conflicting, or unspecified text.

themes.name: Federated learning and privacy guarantees
themes.summary: Papers study federated learning under privacy and heterogeneity, including differential privacy accounting, poly-level optimization, and federated anomaly detection for industrial IoT. Others apply federated learning to additive manufacturing thermal fields, EEG mental state classification, and multi-objective gradient aggregation.

themes.name: Causal discovery and causal inference
themes.summary: Papers advance causal discovery and inference, offering target-centric synthetic benchmarks, enumeration of actual causes, variable clustering in causal graphs, and latent mediation for high-dimensional systems. Others study probabilities of causation in nondeterministic models and causal beam alignment for mmWave communication.

highlights.authors: Zhaojia Wang, Jiucui Lu, Zheng Li

Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity’s /teamwork
news.summary: Google Research described results from Antigravity's /teamwork multiagent systems, built on Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon and Hydrogen models, applied with human experts to open problems in mathematics, chemistry, systems software and ML engineering, including information theory, formal verification, molecular structure and kernel optimization. The system pairs parallel exploration with verifiers such as the Lean 4 proof checker and unmodified test suites, and partitions context so each specialized agent receives only the files and tools it needs, with coordinators handing tasks to fresh successors and critics auditing from clean contexts.

news.title: How AI Is Helping Care Teams Get Patients the Right Care, Sooner
news.summary: Dyania Health's Synapsis AI, a clinical reasoning engine running on NVIDIA-accelerated computing inside a health system's firewall, processes patient records including notes, reports and lab results to produce clinical signals traceable to their source, with clinicians reviewing the evidence. Cleveland Clinic used it to support a study of more than 7,800 aortic valve replacement patients between 2005 and 2021, building a predictive model of valve deterioration and reintervention risk at three, five and ten years; the company builds models with NVIDIA NeMo and optimizes them with TensorRT and TensorRT-LLM.

news.title: Faster Scientific Simulations with New FP64 Algorithms in NVIDIA cuBLAS
news.summary: CUDA Toolkit 13.4.2 adds two cuBLAS algorithms, Ozaki-II and the 2M method, that run double-precision GEMM on integer Tensor Cores while preserving full FP64 accuracy. Reported gains: DGEMM with Ozaki-II is 5.5x faster than native FP64 on NVIDIA VR NVL72 and 3.9x on GB200, CCSD quantum chemistry runs achieve 2x and 1.4x end-to-end FP64 speedups, and BerkeleyGW simulations using 2M ZGEMM achieve 6.6x and 3.9x speedups; NVIDIA Rubin GPUs add the TI16 numeric format and tcgen05.mma instruction.

news.title: Run GPU-Powered Black Hole Interferometry with NVIDIA cuPhoton
news.summary: NVIDIA's cuPhoton.xBeam performs GPU-based correlation for Event Horizon Telescope very-long-baseline interferometry, ingesting VDIF frames, applying delay and fringe corrections, channelizing via FFT, cross-multiplying station pairs and writing visibilities in DiFX SWIN or xbeam-v1 format. On an NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 system with 64 GPUs and GPUDirect Storage, it correlated a 10 TB dataset in 70 seconds, which the post reports as 460x faster than an x86 CPU baseline of 31,992 seconds; the work is done with the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics and MIT Haystack Observatory.

news.title: Run Native DLA Inference in Python on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Using cuDLA
news.summary: The cuda.bindings.cudla module, introduced in cuda-bindings 13.3.0, exposes the cuDLA C++ API to Python for hybrid-mode DLA inference on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, exposing thirteen functions, nine data types and eight enums, with CUDA streams coordinating DLA work with GPU preprocessing and postprocessing. A nine-step inference lifecycle is described, and the post states the same cuDLA Python API applies to NVIDIA RTX Spark.

news.title: When One GPU Isn’t Enough: Serving GLM-5.3 Across Two NVIDIA DGX Stations with vLLM
news.summary: A tutorial serves GLM-5.3 NVFP4, a quantized mixture-of-experts model with 753 billion parameters and 40 billion activated per token, across two NVIDIA DGX Stations connected over ConnectX-8 RDMA using vLLM with tensor parallelism (TP=2), since its roughly 464 GB checkpoint exceeds the 252 GB HBM3e on a single GB300 GPU. AIPerf benchmarks on the SPEED-Bench Coding dataset show output throughput peaking at 607.8 tokens per second at concurrency 16 and falling to 385.0 tokens per second at concurrency 32, with mean request latency of 453.5 seconds.

news.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
news.summary: A walkthrough builds a beverage can pick-and-place simulation in Isaac Sim 6.2 using SimReady OpenUSD assets (UR17G arm, Robotiq 2F-140 gripper, beverage can) from the SimReady Central library on Hugging Face, assembled with agent-generated task code; GPT-6 Sol is used as the example model. It describes SimReady's profile, feature and requirement levels and recommends checking joint settings, movement and contact behavior before running the task.

news.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
news.summary: Hugging Face released XYBench, a benchmark of 8,115 real-world questions testing whether AI assistants recognize the XY problem, where a user's stated request (Y) rests on a misconception about their actual goal (X); it won the Best Resource Paper Award at EMNLP 2026 and was developed with Carnegie Mellon, NVIDIA and Johns Hopkins. The questions come from 1,557 Stack Overflow questions, 184 from Stack Exchange, 102 manually curated examples and 6,272 generated from WikiHow guides; the five evaluated models (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3.5-9B, DeepSeek-V4 Pro) often answered the stated request while keeping focus on the mistaken approach.

news.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
news.summary: llama.cpp and ggml released libraries v1.0.0, committing to major-version bumps for C API and ABI incompatibilities, with semantic versioning rules defined for breaking changes to the public C API, backward-compatible features and bug fixes. The post states llama.cpp supports more than 150 architecture variants plus mainstream speculative decoding methods, and lists distribution channels including Docker, Homebrew, conda-forge, MacPorts, Winget and XCFramework.

news.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1
news.summary: GS Caltex connects no-code models built by process engineers in Amazon SageMaker Canvas to SageMaker Pipelines workflows managed by ML engineers, automating the handoff of preprocessing flows (stored in Amazon S3) and model versions (in Model Registry), with Amazon EventBridge scheduling runs. The company reports ML engineers now deploy models within a few hours versus about a week before, and runs batch inference every 30 minutes, which it says has lowered inference costs.

news.title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
news.summary: AWS describes a sample that deploys LiteLLM with the open source NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing plugin on Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate, calling models on Amazon Bedrock, to route coding-agent requests by cost per solved task rather than price per token. Two strategies are supported, stage routing (choosing between a capable and a lower-cost model based on recent tool activity) and random routing with optional weights; the sample uses switchyard-server 0.3.0 and the LiteLLM v1.102.0 image and is designated non-production.

news.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime with platformVersion "V2" prepares a session environment once, snapshots the microVM and restores it for each new session instead of initializing the container per session, and reclaims unused session memory. The post gives four patterns for faster startup — switching to V2 with initialization before app.run(), using build hooks, and pre-warming sessions on user engagement — noting the first healthy ping must arrive within 120 seconds and that each create or update now takes a few minutes to build the snapshot.

news.title: OpenFold3 on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: Predict biomolecular structures
news.summary: OpenFold3-preview, an open source all-atom biomolecular structure prediction model from the OpenFold Consortium and the AlQuraishi Lab at Columbia University, is deployable from Amazon SageMaker JumpStart using model ID huggingface-proteinfolding-openfold3 on ml.g6.2xlarge, ml.g6.4xlarge (default) or ml.g6.12xlarge instances. Version 0.4.1 (of3-p2-155k checkpoint) is Apache 2.0 licensed, predicts protein, DNA, RNA and ligand structures in mmCIF output with pLDDT, PAE and PDE confidence metrics, and runs on asynchronous inference endpoints with network isolation and scale-to-zero.

However, if that same orchestrator model delegates to a cheaper sub-agent, which is what these harnesses are built to do, the same models on the same facts fail on 20/180, 44/180, 75/180 and 553/900. highlights.title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
highlights.theme: LLM agents: evaluation, memory, and multi-agent safety
highlights.why: 它梳理了 516 个多智能体 LLM 配置中的协调、集成和测试时计算，表明多智能体系统经常不如匹配的基线。
highlights.key_result: 在包含 516 个独特多智能体配置的 9 项研究中，一旦单智能体基线获得重复样本或匹配的计算预算，多智能体系统并未显示出一致的优势。在与按样本数或预算匹配的基线对比时，平均差为 -0.042（REML = -0.195，CR2 95% CI [ -0.320, -0.070]），并且在 474 个对比中，多智能体系统的准确率在 74% 的情况下等于或低于其基线（tab:baseline_tiers）。
evidence: Across 9 studies comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations, multi-agent systems show no consistent advantage once single-agent baselines receive repeated samples or matched compute budgets. Against baselines matched on sample count or budget the mean difference is -0.042 (REML = -0.195, CR2 95% CI [ -0.320, -0.070]), and the multi-agent system's accuracy equals or falls below its baseline's in 74% of the 474 contrasts ( tab:baseline_tiers).

highlights.title: Reasoning Models Confabulate to Defend Injected Beliefs About Their Own Requests
highlights.theme: Interpretability and activation steering for LLMs
highlights.why: 它表明推理模型会虚构内容以捍卫由激活注入的关于自身请求的信念，这是思维链可监控性的一个具体局限。
highlights.key_result: 一种在提示文本中不可见的激活编辑——注入的离题概念的形成痕迹（forming-trace）——覆盖了推理模型对其自身请求的信念：在涵盖规模、架构和训练配方的六个模型中，注入的主题成为它进行推理、报告和回答的任务；强制回读在 48 个模型-概念单元中的 47 个返回了注入的主题，并且在四个具有干净最终俳句的模型中，注入的答案在 99% 的生成中随之出现。警告几乎无法改变它：即使明确命名真实主题，真实主题答案也不到 5%。
evidence: An activation edit invisible in the prompt text, the injected forming-trace of an off-topic concept, overwrites a reasoning model's belief about its own request: across six models spanning scale, architecture, and recipe, the injected topic becomes the task it reasons about, reports back, and answers: the forced quote-back returns the injected topic in 47 of 48 model-concept cells, and on the four models with clean final haiku the injected answer follows in 99% of generations.
Warnings barely move it: even one naming the true topic yields under 5% true-topic answers.

highlights.title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
highlights.theme: LLM agents: evaluation, memory, and multi-agent safety
highlights.why: 它表明，在解析器错误的情况下，记忆硬过滤可能将准确率增益转变为损失，这对 LLM 记忆系统设计是一个警示结果。
highlights.key_result: 在完美的解析器标签下，硬丢弃过滤有帮助，在三个模型中增益为 +0.186 到 +0.230，但在最低测试可靠性下反转为 -0.176 到 -0.181 的损失；部署匹配的门控达到 0.655 的准确率，而始终硬丢弃为 0.641，测试指导的预言机选择为 0.662。
evidence: At perfect resolution, hard-drop gains are +0.186, +0.186, and +0.230 for GPT-4o-mini, Haiku, and Sonnet; at the lowest tested reliability they are -0.181, -0.176, and -0.176.
Pooled across 612 held-out environment--query outcomes, accuracy is 0.655 versus 0.569 always-flat, 0.641 always-hard-drop, and 0.583 always-soft-retain.
A test-informed oracle policy reaches 0.662, leaving gate regret 0.007 versus 0.093, 0.021, and 0.078 for the three fixed policies.

highlights.title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
highlights.why: 它在小型量化端侧 LLM 上审计幻觉检测器，揭示了实际部署模型的证据缺口和反转排名。
highlights.key_result: 跨模型排名迁移很差：Spearman rho 为 -0.80，Kendall tau-b 为 -0.667，意味着检测器排名在两个模型之间发生反转，并且在 bootstrap 95 percent 置信区间下，廉价的词汇基线在统计上与基于采样的置信度检测器在两个模型上不可区分。作为第二项方法学贡献，TruthfulQA-Generation 的标准 token 重叠到多项选择正确性标注器在四个检测器、两个模型上产生了接近随机的 AUROC（0.46-0.59），这是标注器失败，而非检测器失败，因为相同检测器在相同流水线下在 TriviaQA 上达到 0.69-0.89 AUROC。
evidence: Cross-model ranking transfer is poor: Spearman rho is -0.80 and Kendall tau-b is -0.667, meaning the detector ranking actively inverts between the two models, and the cheap lexical baseline is statistically indistinguishable from the sampling-based consistency detectors on both models under bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals. As a second, methodological contribution, we show that the standard token-overlap-to-multiple-choice correctness labeler for TruthfulQA-Generation produces near-chance AUROC (0.46-0.59) for all four detectors on both models, a labeler failure, not a detector failure, since the same detectors reach 0.69-0.89 AUROC on TriviaQA under the identical pipeline.

highlights.title: Can LLMs Write Backdoors? An Empirical Security Study of Weight-Space Programming
highlights.authors: Zhaojia Wang, Jiucui Lu, Zheng Li
highlights.why: 它实证表明，LLM 可以通过权重空间编程在多种架构上注入后门，提出了一个新的具体安全问题。
highlights.key_result: LLM 驱动的权重编辑可以在不同架构上成功注入后门，同时基本保持干净性能。GPT-6 Astra 在全部三个目标模型上实现了 100% 的攻击成功率，成功的攻击只需少至 MLP 的 6 个参数，以及微调 Qwen 模型的 0.02% 权重。
evidence: First, LLM-driven weight editing can successfully inject backdoors across different architectures while largely preserving clean performance. Second, successful attacks can require remarkably few parameter modifications, including only six parameters for the MLP and 0.02% of the weights for a fine-tuned Qwen model.

First, LLM-driven weight editing can successfully inject targeted backdoors across different neural architectures while largely preserving clean performance. GPT-6 Astra achieves a 100% attack success rate across all three target models. Second, successful backdoor injection can require remarkably few parameter modifications. For instance, only six parameters are modified in the MLP, while a successful Qwen edit changes merely 0.02% of its weights.

highlights.title: Unfinished-Bench: Measuring Rule Violations by Persistent Agents in Realistic Work Environments
highlights.authors: Seunghyun Lee, Jaehui Hwang, Dongyoon Han et al.
highlights.theme: LLM agents: evaluation, memory, and multi-agent safety
highlights.why: 它引入了 Unfinished-Bench，用于衡量在真实工作环境中持续性智能体的规则违反情况，填补了智能体安全评估的空白。
highlights.key_result: 我们发现，坚持性将内部文档中规则的违反率从 32.2% 提高到 43.6%，是用户陈述同一规则时 8.5% 的五倍。在 12 个开放模型和 13,968 次运行中，坚持性在 24 个模型--位置组合中的 21 个中提高了违反率（ ），并且每个模型违反内部文档中的规则的频率都高于用户陈述的同一规则（ ）。
evidence: We find that persistence raised violations of a rule in an internal document from 32.2% to 43.6%, five times the 8.5% for the same rule stated by the user.

Across 12 open models and 13,968 runs, persistence raised violations in 21 of the 24 model--position combinations ( ), and every model violated rules in internal documents more often than the same rules stated by the user ( ).

highlights.title: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement
highlights.why: 它将辩证能力确定为一个独立的能力，其中模型无法坚持或放弃立场，并提出了一种自我分歧训练方法。
highlights.key_result: 论文表明，在两种基座家族上训练后，模型获得了辩证能力，而无需以牺牲首次回答准确率为代价，并且面对从未训练过的挑战者时仍保持该增益。在 Qwen3-8B 上，经过训练的模型在被挑战后更频繁地稳定在正确答案上，提升 +5.90 pp（从 50.0 % 到 55.9 %）；在 Gemma-2 9B 上平均从 19.9 % 提升到 37.8 %，在每个基准上都领先其自身基座。
evidence: Demonstrating that Self-Disagreement improves it: trained on two base families, the models gain dialectical competence without paying for it in first-answer accuracy ( ), and keep the gain against challengers they never trained against, with an account of where it comes from ( ).

It survives off the training probe, on both base models: On Qwen3-8B the trained model is ahead of the base model on all nine\ public benchmarks, on mathematics and code as well as on the multiple-choice sets where a challenge is cheapest to issue, and on average it settles on the right answer after being challenged +5.90\ pp more often (95 % CI over the nine\ benchmarks [+4.64, +7.16]; over the three training seeds [+5.00, +6.80]), 50.0 % to 55.9 %. The final row of the upper block of Table repeats the whole exercise on a second base model, Gemma-2 9B, and the pattern holds: 19.9 % to 37.8 % on average, ahead of its own base on every benchmark ( ).

Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
Shield helps technicians hand off legacy portal work with OpenAI
Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity’s /teamwork
news.summary: Google Research 描述了 Antigravity 的 /teamwork 多智能体系统的成果，该系统基于 Gemini 4 Argon、Carbon 和 Hydrogen 模型，与人类专家一起应用于数学、化学、系统软件和 ML 工程中的开放问题，包括信息论、形式验证、分子结构和内核优化。该系统将并行探索与验证器（如 Lean 4 证明检查器和未修改的测试套件）配对，并划分上下文，使每个专业智能体仅接收其所需的文件和工具，由协调器将任务移交给全新的继任者，批评者从干净的上下文中进行审计。

news.title: How AI Is Helping Care Teams Get Patients the Right Care, Sooner
news.summary: Dyania Health 的 Synapsis AI 是一个临床推理引擎，运行在医疗系统防火墙内的 NVIDIA 加速计算上，处理包括笔记、报告和实验室结果在内的患者记录，生成可追溯到来源的临床信号，并由临床医生审核证据。克利夫兰诊所使用它支持了一项对 2005 年至 2021 年间超过 7,800 名主动脉瓣置换患者的研究，建立了一个预测瓣膜退化和三年、五年和十年再干预风险的模型；该公司使用 NVIDIA NeMo 构建模型，并使用 TensorRT 和 TensorRT-LLM 进行优化。

news.title: Faster Scientific Simulations with New FP64 Algorithms in NVIDIA cuBLAS
news.summary: CUDA Toolkit 13.4.2 新增了两个 cuBLAS 算法：Ozaki-II 和 2M 方法，它们在整数 Tensor Core 上运行双精度 GEMM，同时保持完整的 FP64 精度。报告显示：在 NVIDIA VR NVL72 上，使用 Ozaki-II 的 DGEMM 比原生 FP64 快 5.5x，在 GB200 上快 3.9x；CCSD 量子化学运行实现了 2x 和 1.4x 的端到端 FP64 加速；使用 2M ZGEMM 的 BerkeleyGW 模拟实现了 6.6x 和 3.9x 的加速；NVIDIA Rubin GPU 新增了 TI16 数值格式和 tcgen05.mma 指令。

news.title: Run GPU-Powered Black Hole Interferometry with NVIDIA cuPhoton
news.summary: NVIDIA 的 cuPhoton.xBeam 为事件视界望远镜的甚长基线干涉测量执行基于 GPU 的相关处理，摄取 VDIF 帧，应用延迟和条纹校正，通过 FFT 进行信道化，交叉乘基站对，并以 DiFX SWIN 或 xbeam-v1 格式写入可见度数据。在配备 64 个 GPU 和 GPUDirect Storage 的 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 系统上，它在 70 秒内完成了 10 TB 数据集的相关处理，文章报告这比 x86 CPU 基线（31,992 秒）快 460 倍；这项工作与哈佛-史密森天体物理中心和 MIT Haystack 天文台合作完成。

news.title: Run Native DLA Inference in Python on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Using cuDLA
news.summary: The cuda.bindings.cudla module, introduced in cuda-bindings 13.3.0, exposes the cuDLA C++ API to Python for hybrid-mode DLA inference on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, exposing thirteen functions, nine data types and eight enums, with CUDA streams coordinating DLA work with GPU preprocessing and postprocessing. A nine-step inference lifecycle is described, and the post states the same cuDLA Python API applies to NVIDIA RTX Spark.

news.title: When One GPU Isn’t Enough: Serving GLM-5.3 Across Two NVIDIA DGX Stations with vLLM
news.summary: 一篇教程在通过 ConnectX-8 RDMA 连接的两台 NVIDIA DGX Station 上使用 vLLM 和张量并行（TP=2）部署 GLM-5.3 NVFP4，这是一个量化混合专家模型，拥有 753 billion 参数，每个 token 激活 40 billion 参数，因为其约 464 GB 的检查点超过了单个 GB300 GPU 上的 252 GB HBM3e。在 SPEED-Bench Coding 数据集上的 AIPerf 基准显示，在并发 16 时输出吞吐量峰值达到 607.8 tokens per second，在并发 32 时降至 385.0 tokens per second，平均请求延迟为 453.5 秒。

news.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
news.summary: 一篇操作指南介绍了在 Isaac Sim 6.2 中使用来自 Hugging Face 上 SimReady Central 库的 SimReady OpenUSD 资产（UR17G 机械臂、Robotiq 2F-140 夹爪、饮料罐）构建饮料罐拾放仿真，并使用智能体生成的任务代码进行组装；示例模型为 GPT-6 Sol。文中描述了 SimReady 的配置文件、功能和需求级别，并建议在运行任务前检查关节设置、运动和接触行为。

news.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
news.summary: Hugging Face 发布了 XYBench，一个包含 8,115 个真实世界问题的基准，测试 AI 助手是否识别 XY 问题（用户陈述的请求 Y 建立在其实际目标 X 的误解之上）；该基准获得 EMNLP 2026 最佳资源论文奖，与卡内基梅隆大学、NVIDIA 和约翰霍普金斯大学共同开发。问题来自 1,557 个 Stack Overflow 问题、184 个 Stack Exchange 问题、102 个人工整理示例以及 6,272 个根据 WikiHow 指南生成的问题；五个评估模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen3.5-9B、DeepSeek-V4 Pro）常常在回答所述请求的同时，仍专注于错误的方法。

news.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
news.summary: llama.cpp 和 ggml 发布了 v1.0.0 库，承诺对 C API 和 ABI 不兼容进行主版本号升级，并定义了针对公共 C API 破坏性变更、向后兼容功能和错误修复的语义化版本规则。文章指出，llama.cpp 支持超过 150 种架构变体和主流投机解码方法，并列出包括 Docker、Homebrew、conda-forge、MacPorts、Winget 和 XCFramework 在内的分发渠道。

news.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1
news.summary: GS Caltex 将工艺工程师在 Amazon SageMaker Canvas 中构建的无代码模型连接到由 ML 工程师管理的 SageMaker Pipelines 工作流，自动化预处理流程（存储在 Amazon S3 中）和模型版本（在 Model Registry 中）的交接，并使用 Amazon EventBridge 调度运行。该公司报告称，ML 工程师现在在几小时内即可部署模型，而之前大约需要一周，并且每 30 分钟运行一次批量推理，据称降低了推理成本。

news.title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
news.summary: AWS 描述了一个示例，该示例在 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon ECS 中部署 LiteLLM 并使用开源 NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard 路由插件，调用 Amazon Bedrock 上的模型，以按每个已解决任务的成本而非每个 token 的价格来路由编码智能体请求。支持两种策略：阶段路由（根据近期工具活动在能力较强和成本较低的模型之间选择）和带可选权重的随机路由；该示例使用 switchyard-server 0.3.0 和 LiteLLM v1.102.0 镜像，并被指定为非生产用途。

news.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
news.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 运行时使用 platformVersion "V2" 一次性准备会话环境，对 microVM 进行快照并在每个新会话中恢复它，而不是为每个会话初始化容器，并回收未使用的会话内存。文章给出了四种加快启动速度的模式——在 app.run() 之前初始化并切换到 V2、使用构建钩子以及在用户参与时预热会话——并指出第一次健康 ping 必须在 120 秒内到达，并且现在每次创建或更新都需要几分钟来构建快照。

news.title: OpenFold3 on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: Predict biomolecular structures
news.summary: OpenFold3-preview 是一个开源的全原子生物分子结构预测模型，来自 OpenFold 联盟和哥伦比亚大学 AlQuraishi 实验室，可通过 Amazon SageMaker JumpStart 使用模型 ID huggingface-proteinfolding-openfold3 在 ml.g6.2xlarge、ml.g6.4xlarge（默认）或 ml.g6.12xlarge 实例上部署。版本 0.4.1（of3-p2-155k 检查点）采用 Apache 2.0 许可，可预测蛋白质、DNA、RNA 和配体结构，输出 mmCIF 格式，并提供 pLDDT、PAE 和 PDE 置信度指标，运行在具有网络隔离和 scale-to-zero 的异步推理端点上。
